decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Condition 9
Reason:
The Council is satisfied that the scaffolding would preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the listed building and the Cavalry Barracks Conservation Area, and is in compliance with policies ENV-B.2.7 Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character, ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the Unitary Development Plan.
Condition 11: 
The Council is satisfied that the demolition surveys are acceptable and would preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the listed building and the Cavalry Barracks Conservation Area, and is in compliance with policies ENV-B.2.7 Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character, ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the Unitary Development Plan.
description: Details of measures to protect the safety and stability of the existing building during the works required by condition 9 and details of any further enabling works that may be necessary to carry out the scheme required by condition 11 of planning permission 00092/A/L11 dated 11/04/2011 for the internal creation of 81 bedrooms within the existing Grade II listed Hardinge Block.
